column1: # NumPy coverage checklist (rstsr-core) — full core_func surface.
# numpy_source_hash = sha256[:12] of the NumPy test function source at the pinned
#   version (recompute via `python3 sync_numpy.py <numpy_root>`). Changed hash on a
#   transferred/partial row => the rstsr translation may be stale (see core-numpy-sync).
#   and unary/binary math + comparison + basic indexing (in progress).
#   Gap functions rstsr does not implement (split/dstack/column_stack/block/tile/...)
